card.name: Digits inside ISBN and journal numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit inside a long identifier number, mostly the first digit of the publisher part after the hyphen in an ISBN. Also digits inside journal volume numbers and ISSN codes in citations.

modes.label: ISBN publisher digit
modes.description: The digit right after 'ISBN 1-' or '978-1-' in a book citation.

modes.label: Digit in journal or serial numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a journal volume number, ISSN or sequence code in a reference.

card.plain: It marks a digit in the middle of a long catalog number, such as a book ISBN in a reference list.
